svg.aria-label: Two bands. In the top band, a coordinate plane with a marked origin and the line three x plus five y equals fifteen, which falls to the right. Two gold dots are placed on the axes first, one on the horizontal axis at five and one on the vertical axis at three, each labelled with its value and with the lowercase words x-intercept and y-intercept, and then the blue line is drawn through both of them. Below a full-width hairline, the two substitutions that gave those values. Setting y to zero leaves three x equals fifteen, so x is five, and setting x to zero leaves five y equals fifteen, so y is three.
